WITH players_of_team AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_id,
    p.first_name,
    p.last_name
  FROM public.players p
  JOIN public.roster r
    ON p.player_id = r.player_id
   AND r.team_id = 1
),

skater_appearances AS (
  -- Only games where this player appears as 'S'
  SELECT
    gr.player_id,
    gr.game_id
  FROM public.game_roster gr
  WHERE gr.team_id = 1
    AND gr.position = 'S'
),

goals AS (
  SELECT
    se.goal_scorer_id AS player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS goals
  FROM public.scoring_event se
  JOIN skater_appearances sa
    ON sa.game_id = se.game_id
   AND sa.player_id = se.goal_scorer_id
  WHERE se.team_id = 1
    AND se.goal_scorer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY se.goal_scorer_id
),

assists AS (
  SELECT
    aid.player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS assists
  FROM (
    SELECT se.assist_1_id AS player_id, se.game_id
    FROM public.scoring_event se
    WHERE se.team_id = 1
      AND se.assist_1_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT se.assist_2_id AS player_id, se.game_id
    FROM public.scoring_event se
    WHERE se.team_id = 1
      AND se.assist_2_id IS NOT NULL
  ) aid
  JOIN skater_appearances sa
    ON sa.game_id = aid.game_id
   AND sa.player_id = aid.player_id
  GROUP BY aid.player_id
),

penalties AS (
  SELECT
    pe.player_id,
    COALESCE(ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM SUM(pe.duration)) / 60)::int, 0) AS penalty_minutes
  FROM public.penalty_event pe
  JOIN skater_appearances sa
    ON sa.game_id = pe.game_id
   AND sa.player_id = pe.player_id
  WHERE pe.team_id = 1
  GROUP BY pe.player_id
),

appearance_games AS (
  SELECT
    sa.player_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.game_id) AS games_played
  FROM skater_appearances sa
  GROUP BY sa.player_id
)

SELECT
  pot.first_name || ' ' || pot.last_name AS player_name,
  COALESCE(ag.games_played, 0) AS gp,
  COALESCE(g.goals, 0) AS g,
  COALESCE(a.assists, 0) AS a,
  (COALESCE(g.goals, 0) + COALESCE(a.assists, 0)) AS pts,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ag.games_played, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(
      (COALESCE(g.goals, 0) + COALESCE(a.assists, 0))::numeric
      / COALESCE(ag.games_played, 0), 2
    )
  END AS pts_per_gp,
  COALESCE(pe.penalty_minutes, 0) AS pim
FROM players_of_team pot
LEFT JOIN goals g
  ON pot.player_id = g.player_id
LEFT JOIN assists a
  ON pot.player_id = a.player_id
LEFT JOIN penalties pe
  ON pot.player_id = pe.player_id
LEFT JOIN appearance_games ag
  ON pot.player_id = ag.player_id
ORDER BY pts DESC, g DESC, a DESC, pot.last_name;
